versions.changelog:
Major update: Adds support for Chinese platforms and expands social media automation.

- Added support for domestic platforms including 小宇宙、喜马拉雅、B站、小红书等
- Introduced social media content package generation for both international and Chinese platforms
- Added highlight clip extraction feature with timestamps
- Improved Discord integration and configuration flexibility
- Updated file structure and usage instructions for easier multi-platform workflows
Initial release: pre-production and post-production automation
